articles.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

articles.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
articles.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

articles.description: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says

articles.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader

articles.title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike

articles.title: Ex-investigator admits depriving war crimes probe of potentially valuable information
